question: An operations manager finds she hits her usage limit before lunch nearly every working day and is frustrated by the interruption. What should she do first?
options: A) Upgrade immediately to the highest plan tier available so the daily interruptions simply stop happening.
B) Review the usage view in her settings to see what recent sessions actually consumed, before changing anything.
C) Switch every task to the deepest-reasoning model so that fewer follow-up messages are needed to finish.
D) Move all of her work into brand-new chats each morning so that every conversation starts with an empty window.
correct_answers: B) Review the usage view in her settings to see what recent sessions actually consumed, before changing anything.
explanations: Incorrect. An upgrade may be justified later, but buying more allowance before understanding what consumes it is guesswork.
Correct. The fix depends on the cause, and the usage view shows how much of her session and weekly allowance has gone. Diagnosing first avoids paying for a change that would not help.
Incorrect. The deepest-reasoning tier consumes meaningfully more allowance per message, so this is likely to make matters worse.
Incorrect. A fresh window addresses a length limit, not a usage limit, which follows her across all conversations.
